items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Has Two New Robotics And Industrial Network Hooks
items.summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) launched the ATFCD52 high speed capacitance digitizer for robotic tactile sensing and grip control. The business added EtherCAT and Time Sensitive Networking support to its PolarFire FPGA solution stack for industrial edge networks. These updates target uses in advanced robotics, augmented reality devices and smart infrastructure systems.
